name: Garlic-Infused Oil

low.description: 1 tablespoon - use freely for garlic flavor

siboNotes: GAME CHANGER for SIBO cooking! Fructans are water-soluble but NOT oil-soluble. So garlic-infused oil provides garlic flavor without FODMAPs. The key to flavorful low-FODMAP cooking.
preparationTips: Or make your own: heat oil, add garlic, remove garlic before using
